Johar! Every journey begins with a dream, and every dream has the power to inspire.
In the third episode of The Green Mic, we bring you an inspiring conversation with Dipali Riya, Miss Universe Jharkhand 2026, whose journey reflects confidence, perseverance, and the courage to dream beyond boundaries. Hailing from Bokaro, Dipali earned the Miss Universe Jharkhand 2026 crown after months of dedicated preparation and is now set to represent the state on the national stage.
